  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS -JANUARY 2024  
  SUBJECT: MIE 1071 / MIE-1071 - BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING  
  BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING [MIE 1071]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          A boiler supplies steam at 3 N/mm2 and 300oC at 5000 kg/hr. The feed water is supplied  
  at 30oC. Fuel is supplied at 800kg/hr whose calorific value is 22MJ/kg.  
  i) Find the boiler efficiency.  
  ii) If the efficiency of boiler is to be increased by 5% in absolute terms, what should be  
  the ratio of steam generation rate to fuel consumption rate assuming the heat gained by  
  water in the boiler remain same?                                                           (4)  
  iii) If an economiser is used to preheat the feed water by 5oC and reduce fuel  
  consumption by 5%, what will be the new efficiency?  
  Assume the specific heat of water as 4.18 kJ/kgK and that of superheated steam as 2.25  
  kJ/kgK.  
  
  1B)          5kg of steam at a pressure of 2bar is supplied to a pipeline at 200oC. Due to poor  
  insulation, steam loses 2000kJ of heat in the pipeline at constant pressure conditions.  
  The steam coming out of the pipeline is further supplied to a turbine where the steam  
  condition must be superheated with a degree of superheat of 100oC. What quantity of         (3)  
  heat should be supplied to steam at the pipeline exit if the required condition of steam  
  has to be achieved at turbine inlet? Assume the specific heat of superheated steam as  
  2.25 kJ/KgK.  
  
  1C)          Explain any three differences between boiler mounting and boiler accessories.  
  (3)  
  
  2A)          An electric bike makes use of flat open belt drive for power transmission between motor  
  shaft and wheel shaft. The shafts are placed at a centre distance of 500mm. The velocity  
  ratio of the drive is limited to 3. The maximum tension in the belt is found to be 1740 N.  
  The speed and diameter of the driver pulley are 300 rpm and 100 mm respectively. What (4)  
  is the power transmitted by the belt drive? What will be the length of belt? Assume the  
  coefficient of friction between the belt and the pulley surface as 0.3.  
  
  2B)          The following gear wheels are available to form a compound gear train. Sketch the           (3)  
  arrangement of gear train to get maximum velocity ratio using four shafts and calculate  
  the same. Also mention the conditions used to achieve maximum velocity ratio.

  2C)             List ANY THREE advantages of belt drive system and chain drive system?  
  (3)  
  
  3A)             A twin cylinder diesel engine admitting charge in to the engine cylinder in an indirect  
  manner has fuel consumption as 0.257 kg/kWh at 25 cycles per second. The calorific  
  value of diesel is 43,900 kJ/kg. The net brake load is 70 kg and the mean circumference (4)  
  of the brake drum is 4m. Determine the brake thermal efficiency of the engine.  
  
  3B)             Identify and explain the working of an I.C engine which admits the charge in an indirect  
  manner and has a compression ratio of 9.                                                 (3)  
  
  3C)             Justify the following statements:  
  i) Brake Power cannot be equal or more than Indicated Power  
  ii) Two stroke engines do not need a cam shaft                                           (3)  
  iii) Heavier flywheel is used in 4 stroke engines.  
  
  4A)             Identify and hence explain the lathe operations for the following with neat sketches  
  i) Removal of sharp corners on shaft ends                                                (4)  
  ii) To get serrated surface which helps in effective gripping  
  
  4B)             Compare the following drilling operations with the help of neat sketches: Reaming and  
  Boring                                                                                   (3)  
  
  4C)             Why additive manufacturing is called so? List the steps involved in making of parts  
  using this technique.                                                                    (3)  
  
  5A)             Explain the significance of the following moulding sand properties  
  i) Permeability  
  ii) Flowability                                                                          (4)  
  iii) Cohesiveness  
  iv) Refractoriness  
  
  5B)             Suggest a suitable welding process that makes use of a non-consumable electrode and  
  facilitates joining of dissimilar metals.                                                (3)  
  
  5C)             What advantages do you see with installation of CNC machines on a shop floor? List  
  any 6 points.                                                                            (3)
